title: 5 Best Moments From ‘Camp Rock 3,’ From a Surprise Demi Lovato Cameo to the Final Jam
summary: As a new generation of campers take the stage, emotional surprises and familiar faces feature in the Disney sequel.
contentText:
It’s been almost two decades since fans first met Mitchie Torres and the campers of Camp Rock . Now, the beloved franchise grows with the release of Camp Rock 3 .

The new film introduces a fresh batch of campers hoping to earn their place in the spotlight while also bringing back some familiar faces, including the beloved members of Connect 3, played once again by the Jonas Brothers. When the band announces that they are looking for an opening act for their tour, the campers are put through a series of three challenges that test not only their musical chops, but also their ability to work together.

The challenges lead to the film’s climatic final jam, where the remaining campers get one last opportunity to prove that they have what it takes to support Connect 3 on the road. During the journey, some of the movie’s most memorable scenes have little to do with winning. The campers find themselves forming unexpected friendships, confronting their own insecurities and discovering that making music can be just as much about connecting with other people as it is about putting on an amazing performance.

For longtime fans of the Camp Rock films, this new addition has a few surprises of its own. From an unexpected songwriting lesson with a Camp Rock alum to a surprise appearance before the final jam, here are five of the biggest moments from Camp Rock 3 .

The following contains spoilers for Camp Rock 3 , including details about the film’s final jam and its outcome.
